topic_scope_candidate: data-driven constitutive and multiscale computational mechanics

inclusion_rules.scope_definition: Compile one bounded 2017-2021 packet around data-driven constitutive and multiscale computational mechanics, keeping clustering-based modeling and one learned alternative visible without broadening into random cross-domain papers.
hard_exclusion_rules: exclude papers published after 2021 from packet inputs
exclude random exploration papers that do not stay inside the computational-mechanics slice
exclude same-slice expansions when they enlarge the packet without improving role coverage for the first bounded handoff
role_assignment_rules: core_method papers must anchor the constitutive or clustering route family under the cutoff
resource_or_benchmark papers must keep data or database-conditioning constraints visible for downstream replay
limitation_or_critique papers must preserve sensitivity or stability caveats inside the same slice
survey_or_review papers may frame the packet boundary but cannot replace direct route evidence
alternative_route papers must stay inside the same slice while remaining meaningfully distinct from the main support cluster
inclusion_rules.leakage_policy: No papers after the 2021 cutoff may enter packet input. Later syntheses and broader deep-learning retrospectives are audit only. Hindsight labels and post-cutoff judgments must stay out of packet compilation.

included_items.inclusion_reason: Anchor paper for the data-driven constitutive route and one of the top Phase 8 relation_assembly exemplars.
included_items.title: Data based derivation of material response

included_items.inclusion_reason: Provides the packet's explicit noisy-database and data-conditioning reference point so downstream replay does not treat data quality as invisible background.

included_items.inclusion_reason: Frames the packet boundary at the multiscale-mechanics level and keeps the data-driven slice legible as one bounded topic rather than a list of isolated methods.

included_items.inclusion_reason: Deep material networks keep one learned multiscale alternative visible without forcing the packet into a second, much broader machine-learning topic family.

included_items.inclusion_reason: Clustering analysis at finite strains is a third core route anchor and keeps the packet tied to the Phase 8 multiscale owner queue instead of only constitutive-response titles.
included_items.title: Self consistent clustering analysis for multiscale modeling at finite strains

included_items.inclusion_reason: Reference-stiffness selection keeps sensitivity inside the packet and serves as the main stability check near the frozen 2021 cutoff.

excluded_items.notes: Neural-ODE viscoelasticity paper is in the neighborhood, but it is post-cutoff and therefore audit-only for the first bounded packet.
Reinforcement-learning traction-separation route broadens the packet toward a different microstructure and fracture-law subproblem.
Geometric deep learning for hyperelasticity stays same-slice, but the first packet already has one learned alternative and keeping this paper would enlarge the packet without filling a missing role.
Random exploration explosive-materials paper is out-of-slice for the computational-mechanics packet and remains a separate Phase 8 edge case.
